title: Direct Lighting & Clustered Shading Overhead
fix_rationale: Evaluating direct light sources and clustered light grid shading is exceeding the GPU budget due to overlapping local light volumes.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) calculating direct light illumination.

fixes.text: Reduce the radius and attenuation distances of overlapping local point and spot lights.
Limit maximum lights per cluster cell (r.LightGrid.MaxLightsPerCell 32).
Disable shadow casting on low-impact fill lights.

verify: Toggle off overlapping local lights or clamp light radii and observe DirectLighting duration drop.
